Name: Toxic Spikes
Effect: Entry Hazard. Targets who enter the battlefield become Poisoned. Roll 1 Chance Die for them to become Badly Poisoned instead. Pokémon with immunity to Ground-Type Moves are not affected.
Description: The Pokémon lays a trap of tiny venom-drenched spikes through the battlefield. The battle has not yet begun and the Targets are already defeated.
